groups.name: Marketing team
groups.description: Kamaji leads a radar, a writer and an editor who research, write, check, publish and learn for one product from the marketing pack's own storage, with each publish approved by you unless you say otherwise.

groups.name: Insight team
groups.description: The company's eyes and thin lead: an Analyst reads the numbers and writes the weekly digest, a Radar watches the market read-only. It also sets goals, runs the weekly review and splits the token budget between teams; the founder decides.

groups.name: Marketing team (company)
groups.description: The company's voice: a Writer that only writes, and a Publisher that posts what passed the checks. Publishing, Search Console, sign-in probes and video stats are tool-chain schedules of this team, not separate teams.

groups.name: Financial team
groups.description: Read-only finance: revenue, cohorts, plans, unit economics and what each team's Soots cost. It reports and warns; it never acts on money.

groups.name: Operations team (one job)
groups.description: A team for one operational job of the company (a catalog, an inventory, a content import). Use it once per job: the job's pack comes from the product, so the template carries none.

groups.name: Support team
groups.description: Kamaji leads a website answerer and a feedback desk: visitors get answers from your product facts, and what they ask, report or want lands as voice-of-customer rows for you.

groups.name: Simulated society
groups.description: A persona crowd, an expert panel and an analyst judge your feature, product, price, video or campaign: independent first impressions, social rounds, then a cited report.

groups.name: Server watch
groups.description: One server-care Soot checks your host every morning and files remediations that wait for your approval; nothing runs until you resume the schedule and approve each fix.
